description: An emergency department operations manager must approve and configure stocking a rare emergency antidote in a satellite emergency department, with input from toxicology, pharmacy logistics, and finance.

shared_context.S1: The satellite emergency department currently has no stock of the rare emergency antidote used for a time-sensitive exposure treatment.
shared_context.S2: Marisol makes the final decision about whether and how the antidote will be stocked there.
shared_context.S3: The emergency department's medication room has a designated locked cabinet available for a new emergency medication.
shared_context.S4: The department's weekly emergency-readiness huddle is held before stocking decisions are finalized, and the clinical, pharmacy, and finance representatives report their implementation requirements during that huddle.

PF1.text: The toxicology protocol calls for two 10-mL vials of the 25 mg/mL formulation to be immediately available in the satellite emergency department for the relevant exposure pathway; Dr. Chen reviewed the protocol with the toxicology service, but the stocking request has not yet been entered.

PF2.text: The antidote must be stored at 2-8 degrees Celsius, and pharmacy logistics can place it in the satellite department's medication refrigerator with a temperature-log check at the start of each shift; Ibrahim confirmed the refrigerator space is available.

PF3.text: The manufacturer sells the antidote only in four-vial packs, and finance has approved the emergency purchase under authorization code EM-4721; Leah verified that this four-vial purchase is covered by the current emergency-medication allocation.

acceptance_conditions: The stocked formulation must be exactly 25 mg/mL.
Exactly four vials must be purchased.
The purchase must use authorization code EM-4721.
The antidote must be placed in the satellite department medication refrigerator with a temperature-log check at the start of each shift.
The toxicology protocol must be cited as justification for the formulation and stocking decision.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'refrigerated_storage' and c['target'] == 'Satellite ED Medication Room' and c['detail'] == '2-8 degrees Celsius with temperature-log check at the start of each shift' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The toxicology protocol changes the formulation from an unspecified emergency medication to exactly 25 mg/mL and supplies the clinical justification that must be cited.
The pharmacy storage requirement changes the plan from unspecified cabinet storage to 2-8 degree Celsius refrigeration with a temperature-log check at the start of each shift.
The manufacturer pack size changes the purchase quantity to exactly four vials, while the finance approval changes the authorization entry to EM-4721.
